title: Battle on the Planta
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle on the Planta", at revision 1370603371, opens: "The Battle on the Planta, fought on 13 November 1475 around Conthey near Sion, Valais, Switzerland, was part of the Burgundian Wars." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q319592, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1475 battle between the Old Swiss Confederacy and the Duchy of Savoy during the Burgundian Wars". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
